name: Thyme
shortDescription: Tiny leaves and a warm, earthy flavour.
description: Thyme is a compact, woody herb with small aromatic leaves. Its flowers are also attractive to pollinators.
use: Soups, stews and roasted vegetables. Bees love its flowers.
growingTips: Choose a sunny position with well-drained soil. Trim lightly after flowering to keep the plant neat.
